title: Crypto security chiefs sound alarm as PHP emergency patch scrambles devs worldwide
summary: PHP released fixes on Oct. 21 for two critical vulnerabilities that can let unauthenticated attackers run code on web servers, as crypto security executives urged operators to patch and check overlooked infrastructure. The PHP team's security advisory identifies CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, following its Oct. 20 advance warning.
